title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
summary: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
